THE IDEA

Project overview.

An interactive football tactics studio for exploring ground-pass decisions. Move players and the ball, adjust the passing foot, and inspect movement and interception estimates to understand why a passing lane may work.

Areas of exploration

  • Interactive pitch with 22 fictional players
  • Passing recommendations with inspectable evidence
  • Open-lane, pressure, blocked-pass, and offside scenarios
  • Adjustable player orientation and foot preference
  • Core passing calculations run locally

The curiosity behind it.

Connecting an interest in football with a question: what changes when one player moves into a passing lane?

Your turn.

Can you close a passing lane with just one defender?
